title: Living Alone Trend
question: In some countries, many more people are choosing to live alone nowadays than in the past. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
guide:
Dạng bài: Opinion (Positive or Negative).
Gợi ý: Có cả hai mặt.
- Positive (Personal): Rèn luyện sự độc lập, kỹ năng sống (nấu ăn, quản lý tài chính).
- Positive (Economic): Tăng nhu cầu nhà ở, thúc đẩy ngành xây dựng và dịch vụ.
- Negative (Personal): Cảm giác cô đơn, thiếu sự hỗ trợ tinh thần.
- Negative (Economic): Đẩy giá nhà và tiền thuê nhà lên cao.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion.
Body 1: Positive aspects (Independence, economic demand).
Body 2: Negative aspects (Loneliness, rising housing costs).
Conclusion: Summary of both sides.
en:
In recent years it has become far more normal for people to live alone, particularly in large cities in the developed world. In my opinion, this trend could have both positive and negative consequences in equal measure.

The rise in one-person households can be seen as positive for both personal and broader economic reasons. On an individual level, people who choose to live alone may become more independent and self-reliant than those who live with family members. A young adult who lives alone, for example, will need to learn to cook, clean, pay bills and manage his or her budget, all of which are valuable life skills; an increase in the number of such individuals can certainly be seen as a positive development. From an economic perspective, the trend towards living alone will result in greater demand for housing. This is likely to benefit the construction industry, estate agents and a whole host of other companies that rely on homeowners to buy their products or services.

However, the personal and economic arguments given above can be considered from the opposite angle. Firstly, rather than the positive feeling of increased independence, people who live alone may experience feelings of loneliness, isolation and worry. They miss out on the emotional support and daily conversation that family or flatmates can provide, and they must bear the weight of all household bills and responsibilities; in this sense, perhaps the trend towards living alone is a negative one. Secondly, from the financial point of view, a rise in demand for housing is likely to push up property prices and rents. While this may benefit some businesses, the general population, including those who live alone, will be faced with rising living costs.

In conclusion, the increase in one-person households will have both beneficial and detrimental effects on individuals and on the economy.

title: University Choice vs Utility
question: Some people think that all university students should study whatever they like. Others believe that they should only be allowed to study subjects that will be useful in the future, such as those related to science and technology. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
guide:
Dạng bài: Discussion.
Gợi ý:
- Study whatever they like: Đam mê giúp sinh viên học tốt hơn, tư duy sáng tạo (nghệ thuật, triết học) có thể quan trọng hơn kỹ năng kỹ thuật trong tương lai.
- Study useful subjects: Cơ hội việc làm cao, lương tốt, đáp ứng nhu cầu nhân lực của xã hội (y học, kỹ thuật).
- Opinion: Nên được tự do lựa chọn vì đam mê là động lực lớn nhất.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion.
Body 1: Why focus on 'useful' subjects (Jobs, economic growth).
Body 2: Why allow free choice (Passion, creativity, unpredictable future needs).
Conclusion: Summary.
en:
People have different views about how much choice students should have with regard to what they can study at university. While some argue that it would be better for students to be forced into certain key subject areas, I believe that everyone should be able to study the course of their choice.

There are various reasons why people believe that universities should only offer subjects that will be useful in the future. They may assert that university courses like medicine, engineering and information technology are more likely to be beneficial than certain art degrees. From a personal perspective, it can be argued that these courses provide more job opportunities, career progression, better salaries, and therefore an improved quality of life for students who take them. On the societal level, by forcing people to choose particular university subjects, governments can ensure that any knowledge and skill gaps in the economy are covered. Finally, a focus on technology in higher education could lead to new inventions, economic growth, and greater future prosperity.

In spite of these arguments, I believe that university students should be free to choose their preferred areas of study. In my opinion, society will benefit more if our students are passionate about what they are learning. Besides, nobody can really predict which areas of knowledge will be most useful to society in the future, and it may be that employers begin to value creative thinking skills above practical or technical skills. If this were the case, perhaps we would need more students of art, history and philosophy than of science or technology.

In conclusion, although it might seem sensible for universities to focus only on the most useful subjects, I personally prefer the current system in which people have the right to study whatever they like.
vi:

Họ có thể khẳng định rằng các khóa học đại học như y học, kỹ thuật và công nghệ thông tin có nhiều khả năng mang lại lợi ích hơn một số bằng nghệ thuật nhất định. title: Ex-prisoners as Role Models
question: Some people who have been in prison become good citizens later, and it is often argued that these are the best people to talk to teenagers about the dangers of committing a crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Dạng bài: Opinion (Agree/Disagree).
Gợi ý: Hoàn toàn đồng ý.
- Reformed criminals speak from experience: Họ có thể kể lời thật về sự nguy hiểm và cuộc sống khổ cực trong tù, giúp xóa bỏ hào nhoáng giả tạo về tội phạm.
- Credibility: Teenagers thường ít nghe lời cảnh sát hay giáo viên, nhưng sẽ bị ấn tượng mạnh bởi những câu chuyện sống động từ người trong cuộc.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Agree.
Body 1: Why ex-prisoners are effective (Real stories, dispel glamour).
Body 2: Why other methods are less effective (Police/teachers lack credibility/interaction).
Conclusion: Reiterate support.

vocab.meaning: Người phạm tội đã cải tà quy chính

en:
It is true that ex-prisoners can become normal, productive members of society. I completely agree with the idea that allowing such people to speak to teenagers about their experiences is the best way to discourage them from breaking the law.

In my opinion, teenagers are more likely to accept advice from someone who can speak from experience. Reformed offenders can tell young people about how they became involved in crime, the dangers of a criminal lifestyle, and what life in prison is really like. They can also dispel any ideas that teenagers may have about criminals leading glamorous lives. While adolescents are often indifferent to the guidance given by older people, I imagine that most of them would be extremely keen to hear the stories of an ex-offender. The vivid and perhaps shocking nature of these stories is likely to have a powerful impact.

The alternatives to using reformed criminals to educate teenagers about crime would be much less effective. One option would be for police officers to visit schools and talk to young people. This could be useful in terms of informing teens about what happens to lawbreakers when they are caught, but young people are often reluctant to take advice from figures of authority. A second option would be for school teachers to speak to their students about crime, but I doubt that students would see teachers as credible sources of information about this topic. Finally, educational films might be informative, but there would be no opportunity for young people to interact and ask questions.

In conclusion, I fully support the view that people who have turned their lives around after serving a prison sentence could help to deter teenagers from committing crimes.

title: Natural Leaders vs Learned Leadership
question: Some people think that some individuals are naturally good leaders while others think individuals can learn leadership skills. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

- View 2: Leadership skills can be learned – kỹ năng giao tiếp, giải quyết vấn đề đều có thể học.
barem:

- Training programs and experience build leadership capabilities.

sample:
The debate over whether leadership is an innate quality or an acquired skill has been ongoing. While some argue that certain people are born to be leaders, I firmly believe that leadership consists of learnable skills that can be developed through training and experience.

On the one hand, proponents of the idea that leaders are born often point to individuals with a charismatic personality. These natural leaders seem to possess an innate ability to inspire and motivate others effortlessly. For example, historical figures and successful entrepreneurs often exhibit a natural magnetism that draws people towards their vision. This inherent confidence and decisiveness make them stand out in group settings, suggesting that leadership is a genetic predisposition rather than a learned behavior.

On the other hand, many argue that leadership is a set of skills that can be taught and refined. I align with this perspective because effective leadership relies heavily on specific competencies, such as communication, problem-solving, and emotional intelligence. These are not necessarily innate traits; rather, they are capabilities that individuals can develop through education, mentorship, and practical experience. For instance, many corporations invest heavily in leadership training programs because they recognize that employees can reap significant rewards by learning how to manage teams and resolve conflicts efficiently.

In conclusion, while a natural charisma might give some individuals a head start, I believe that true leadership capabilities are primarily learned. Through dedication and the right training, almost anyone can acquire the skills necessary to become an effective and inspiring leader.

title: Should People Change Jobs?
question: Some think that people should not change their jobs while others think they should because it brings advantages for themselves, companies and society. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Có nên chuyển đổi công việc không?
Đặc điểm nổi bật:
- View 1: Không nên đổi việc – ổn định thu nhập, bảo hiểm, thăng tiến, dễ được tuyển dụng hơn.
- View 2: Nên đổi việc – phát triển kỹ năng mới, tìm môi trường phù hợp, cơ hội thăng tiến nhanh.
barem:
Introduction:
- Paraphrase the prompt.
- Thesis: Better to change jobs occasionally to foster personal growth.

Body 1: Staying in one job
- Financial stability, benefits.
- Easier to get promoted within the same company.

Body 2: Changing jobs (Job-hopping)
- Develop new skills, adaptable to new environments.
- Faster career advancement and building a skilled workforce for society.

Conclusion:
- Restate opinion.

vocab.meaning: lực lượng lao động lành nghề

sample:
The question of whether employees should remain in the same job for their entire career or change jobs frequently is a subject of much debate. While staying in one organization offers certain benefits, I believe that occasionally changing jobs is more advantageous for fostering personal growth and professional development.

On the one hand, there are valid reasons why some people prefer to stay in the same job. The primary advantage is financial stability. Employees who remain loyal to a single company often enjoy a steady income, comprehensive health insurance, and retirement benefits. Furthermore, long-term commitment to an organization can make it easier to climb the corporate ladder. Employers tend to trust and promote staff members who have demonstrated loyalty and have a deep understanding of the company's operations and culture.

On the other hand, job-hopping can bring significant advantages to individuals, companies, and society. For individuals, changing jobs provides opportunities to develop new skills and adapt to different work environments, which prevents career stagnation. It often leads to faster career advancement and higher salary increments compared to staying in one place. For companies and society, a mobile workforce means that knowledge and best practices are shared across the industry, contributing to a highly skilled workforce and fostering innovation.

In conclusion, although job security and loyalty are important, I believe that the benefits of changing jobs outweigh the drawbacks. Navigating different roles allows individuals to expand their skill sets and ultimately achieve greater career fulfillment.

- Prevents water scarcity and environmental crises.

They believe that individuals should not be penalized or restricted from using a resource that is vital for basic survival and hygiene. Furthermore, it is often argued that water scarcity is less a result of individual overuse and more a consequence of poor infrastructural management. Leaking pipes, inefficient agricultural practices, and industrial pollution are frequently the primary culprits behind water shortages, meaning the public should not bear the brunt of restrictions.

On the other hand, I side with those who believe that the government must regulate water supply. The most compelling reason is that fresh water is a finite resource, and unchecked consumption can quickly jeopardize our ecosystems. By imposing limits or progressive pricing models, governments can deter wasteful behaviors such as excessive lawn watering or unnecessarily long showers. Moreover, state-level control is highly effective in raising public awareness of the dire consequences of water depletion. When authorities actively manage and restrict supply during droughts, it forces the population to recognize the severity of the situation and adopt more sustainable daily habits.

In conclusion, while water is undeniably a basic human need, unrestricted usage is no longer sustainable. I firmly believe that strict government control is essential to safeguard this precious resource and ensure long-term environmental stability.

- Governments prioritize human welfare over animal welfare.
- Non-governmental organizations suffer from budget deficits.

Conclusion:
- Restate disagreement.

Despite the establishment of various international treaties, there remains a significant inconsistency in how wildlife protection laws are enforced across different countries. In many regions, illegal poaching and the exotic pet trade are still rampant, driven by a persistent lack of public awareness. If we had truly spent an excessive amount of time educating communities and harmonizing legal frameworks, these illicit activities would not continue to pose such a severe threat to animal welfare today.

Secondly, the financial resources allocated to protecting wild animals are far from adequate. In most nations, governments naturally prioritize human welfare—such as healthcare, education, and infrastructure—over environmental concerns. Consequently, state funding for conservation programs is often minimal. This leaves the bulk of the responsibility to non-governmental organizations, which frequently suffer from severe budget deficits. Without sufficient funding, it is nearly impossible for these organizations to maintain anti-poaching patrols, rehabilitate injured animals, or run effective breeding programs for species on the brink of extinction.

In conclusion, rather than wasting resources, humanity is currently under-investing in the preservation of nature. I firmly disagree with the idea that too much time and money are spent on protecting wildlife, as far more comprehensive efforts are urgently needed.

Young people are often deterred by the physical demands of working in the fields and the vulnerability of crops to unpredictable weather conditions. Secondly, the rapid pace of urbanization has created far more lucrative vocational opportunities in cities. The prospect of comfortable office jobs, higher salaries, and modern amenities naturally draws young people away from rural life.

Despite these factors, it is crucial that young people are encouraged to take up farming. Without a new generation of farmers to take over, countries may struggle to produce a fruitful harvest, leading to food shortages and inflation. Furthermore, young people are generally more adaptable and tech-savvy. If they enter the agricultural sector, they can incorporate technology—such as drone surveillance, automated irrigation, and data analytics—to modernize farming practices. This would not only make the profession less labor-intensive but also significantly boost crop yields.

In conclusion, while the challenging nature of the work and the lure of urban careers have driven young people away from farming, they must be encouraged to return. Their participation and ability to innovate are essential for the future of global agriculture.

In conclusion, despite the convenience of modern translation tools, I firmly believe that learning a foreign language is still incredibly valuable. It not only boosts brain function but also provides authentic communication skills that are vital for personal and professional success.

- Society should focus on rehabilitating young offenders.

- Restate opinion.

Those who advocate for punishing parents often point to the influence of the home environment on a child's behavior. They argue that juvenile delinquency is frequently the result of a dysfunctional family life, where a lack of supervision or parental neglect leads youths astray. In cases of domestic abuse, children may develop a cognitive distortion regarding right and wrong, ultimately pushing them towards illegal activities. From this perspective, penalizing parents is seen as a way to force them to take their child-rearing responsibilities more seriously.

However, I firmly believe that individuals who break the law must be held accountable for their own actions, regardless of their upbringing. Punishing a parent for a crime they did not directly commit violates the fundamental principles of justice. Furthermore, holding the actual perpetrators accountable acts as a powerful form of criminal deterrence. If teenagers know that their parents will face the penalty instead of them, they might feel emboldened to continue their reckless behavior. To truly prevent youth crime, society should focus on rehabilitating the young offenders through education and community service, teaching them to take responsibility for their choices rather than shifting the blame to their parents.

In conclusion, while a poor upbringing can contribute to youth crime, I disagree with the idea of punishing parents. Ensuring that young lawbreakers face the consequences of their actions is a much fairer and more effective way to reduce crime.

title: Specialised Sports Facilities vs Public Facilities
question: Some countries achieve international success by building specialised facilities to train top athletes instead of providing sports facilities that everyone can use. Is it a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Xây dựng cơ sở vật chất dành riêng cho thể thao chuyên nghiệp - tích cực hay tiêu cực?
Gợi ý: Negative development. Mặc dù giúp đạt thành tích cao, nhưng ưu tiên tiện ích cộng đồng mang lại lợi ích sức khỏe và kinh tế bền vững hơn.

Body 1: Benefits of elite facilities (national pride, international success).
Body 2: Why public facilities are superior (public health, combating sedentary habits, grassroots talent).

In recent years, some governments have directed a significant portion of their sports budgets towards constructing specialized facilities for top-level athletes, often at the expense of public sports centers. In my opinion, while this approach may yield international medals, it is largely a negative development for society as a whole.

Admittedly, building elite sporting infrastructure has its justifications. To excel in sport at the highest level, athletes require access to cutting-edge equipment and specialized medical care. By heavily investing in these areas, a country significantly increases its chances of chasing international sporting success, such as winning gold medals at the Olympic Games. Such achievements can foster a profound sense of national pride and boost the country's prestige on the global stage.

Furthermore, public sports centers act as grassroots breeding grounds for future talent; without local facilities, many gifted children may never discover their potential.

In conclusion, while team sports are an excellent tool for teaching children how to cooperate, they are not the best method for everyone. A more inclusive approach that incorporates various collaborative activities ensures that all children, regardless of their physical abilities, can develop essential teamwork skills.

Today’s youth are increasingly pragmatic and tend to gravitate towards fields such as finance, marketing, or software development, where the potential for high earnings and rapid career progression is much greater. Secondly, the life of a traditional scientist lacks the glamorous lifestyle that many young people aspire to. The prospect of spending long, solitary hours in a laboratory conducting repetitive experiments simply cannot compete with the dynamic, fast-paced, and socially interactive work environments offered by modern tech startups or corporate enterprises. Consequently, without immediate financial rewards or social prestige, science degrees are frequently overlooked.

The societal consequences of this trend are profound and deeply concerning. The most immediate impact is a severe shortage in the workforce of qualified scientists, researchers, and science teachers. A nation that lacks scientific talent will inevitably struggle to innovate and remain competitive in the global economy. More importantly, a deficit in scientific researchers leads to a stagnation in technological and medical advancements. Without brilliant minds dedicated to the field, crucial scientific breakthroughs—such as the discovery of life-saving vaccines, renewable energy technologies, or solutions to pressing environmental crises like climate change—will be significantly delayed, ultimately putting human welfare at risk.

In conclusion, the declining interest in science subjects at universities is primarily driven by uncompetitive salaries and the lack of a glamorous career image. This hands-on approach ensures that trainees are fully equipped to meet the practical demands of trades such as plumbing or electrical work. This allows young adults to enter the job market and start earning an income much sooner, while simultaneously alleviating the societal shortage of qualified blue-collar workers.

Every individual has different career aspirations and intellectual capabilities; therefore, a one-size-fits-all approach pushing everyone towards vocational work is flawed. Furthermore, the lack of tradespeople could also be addressed through alternative methods such as on-the-job training or apprenticeships provided by businesses, meaning that formal university studies do not necessarily need to be sacrificed to meet this demand.

In conclusion, although promoting vocational training is a sensible and cost-effective measure to resolve the current shortage of skilled laborers, it should only be encouraged for those whose interests align with such trades. title: Should Rich People Pay More Taxes?
question: Some people think that it is better for a country's economy if people who are already rich pay more taxes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Người giàu có nên đóng thuế cao hơn?
Gợi ý: Đồng ý một phần. Giúp tái phân phối thu nhập và đầu tư công, nhưng nếu quá cao sẽ làm giảm động lực kinh doanh và gây ra tình trạng chảy máu chất xám.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Advantages of progressive taxation (funding public services, reducing wealth gap).
Body 2: Disadvantages of excessive taxation (stifling entrepreneurship, capital flight/brain drain).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
The question of whether wealthy individuals should bear a heavier tax burden is a central theme in modern economic policy. While I agree that progressive taxation is essential for social equity and public funding, I believe that excessively high taxes on the rich can have detrimental effects on a country's economic dynamism.

On the one hand, requiring the wealthy to pay more taxes is beneficial for the overall economy. Increased tax revenue from those who can afford it allows governments to invest in vital public services such as education, healthcare, and infrastructure. These investments create a more skilled workforce and a better-connected society, which are fundamental drivers of long-term economic growth. Furthermore, a progressive tax system helps to narrow the wealth gap, reducing social tensions and ensuring that the benefits of economic prosperity are more widely shared among the population.

On the other hand, there are significant risks associated with taxing the rich too heavily. High tax rates can discourage entrepreneurship and investment. If individuals feel that a disproportionate amount of their earnings will be taken by the state, they may be less inclined to start new businesses or expand existing ones, which ultimately leads to fewer jobs and less innovation. Additionally, extreme taxation can trigger 'brain drain' or capital flight, as wealthy individuals and talented professionals move to countries with more favorable tax environments. This loss of talent and capital can severely weaken a nation's competitive edge.

In conclusion, while I support the principle that the rich should contribute more to the state, a balance must be struck. Taxation should be high enough to fund essential services and promote fairness, but not so high that it stifles the very economic activity that generates wealth in the first place.

Gợi ý: Kiểm soát là cần thiết để tránh lãng phí, nhưng cần đảm bảo mức sử dụng cơ bản là miễn phí hoặc giá rẻ cho mọi người dân.

sample:
Fresh water is a fundamental requirement for human survival, yet it is becoming an increasingly scarce resource. The debate over whether governments should strictly control its supply or provide it for free highlights a complex challenge. In my opinion, while basic water needs should be guaranteed, strict regulation is necessary to prevent waste and ensure long-term sustainability.

Those who advocate for free access to fresh water argue that it is a basic human right. They believe that no individual should be denied access to clean water due to an inability to pay. Free water ensures that even the most impoverished members of society can maintain hygiene and health, thereby preventing water poverty and the spread of diseases. From this perspective, the government has a moral obligation to provide this essential life source to all citizens without charge, similar to how basic education or primary healthcare is managed in many nations.

However, others argue that strict government control is essential because fresh water is a limited resource. When a resource is provided for free, there is often little incentive for consumers to use it responsibly, leading to widespread waste in both domestic and industrial sectors. By controlling the supply and implementing a pricing system, governments can encourage conservation and fund the maintenance of water infrastructure. Strict regulation also allows for the fair distribution of water during periods of drought, ensuring that essential sectors like agriculture and public health are prioritized over non-essential uses like swimming pools or car washes.

In my view, the most effective approach is a tiered system. Governments should provide a basic quota of fresh water for free or at a very low cost to every household to satisfy essential needs. Beyond this limit, however, strict controls and higher prices should be applied to discourage excessive consumption. This ensures both social equity and environmental responsibility.

In conclusion, while I acknowledge the importance of water as a human right, the reality of water scarcity necessitates careful government management. A regulated system that protects the vulnerable while penalizing waste is the best way to safeguard this precious resource.

title: Researching the History of One's Home
question: In some countries, more and more people are becoming interested in finding out about the history of the house or building they live in. What are the reasons for this? How can people research this?
guide:
Chủ đề: Tìm hiểu lịch sử ngôi nhà đang ở.
Gợi ý: Lý do: Kết nối với quá khứ, giá trị tinh thần/vật chất. Cách tìm kiếm: Lưu trữ công, phỏng vấn hàng xóm, hồ sơ đất đai.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (curiosity about previous occupants, emotional connection to the property, verifying structural/historical value).
Body 2: Methods (local archives, census records, talking to elderly neighbors, architectural analysis).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: những người chủ/cư dân trước đó

sample:
There is a growing trend in many societies where homeowners are increasingly curious about the historical background of their residences. This fascination often stems from a desire to connect with the past, and there are several practical methods through which this information can be uncovered.

The primary reason for this interest is a deep-seated human curiosity about those who came before us. For many, knowing the stories of the previous occupants provides a tangible connection to history and adds a layer of emotional value to their home. Furthermore, understanding the architectural evolution of a building can help owners appreciate its unique character and ensure that any renovations are historically sensitive. In some cases, discovering a house’s prestigious past can even increase its market value, as properties with a documented history are often more desirable to potential buyers.

Researching the history of a building has become more accessible in the modern age. One of the most effective methods is to visit local public archives or libraries, which often house historical maps, census records, and land registry documents. These records can reveal when a house was built and who the registered owners were over several decades. Additionally, digital archives have made it possible to search newspaper records for any significant events that may have occurred at the address. For those living in close-knit communities, interviewing elderly neighbors can also provide invaluable oral histories and personal anecdotes that official documents might lack.

In conclusion, the desire to research home history is driven by a blend of personal curiosity and a respect for heritage. By utilizing both official archives and local knowledge, individuals can piece together the fascinating story of the buildings they inhabit.

title: Banning Violent Films and Books
question: Some people think that the government should ban certain films and books which contain violence. Others think that individuals should be free to choose what they want to watch and read. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Có nên cấm phim ảnh/sách bạo lực?
Gợi ý: Không nên cấm hoàn toàn vì vi phạm quyền tự do, nhưng cần có hệ thống phân loại lứa tuổi nghiêm ngặt để bảo vệ trẻ em.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Government ban (protecting public morality, reducing potential for copycat violence).
View 2: Individual freedom (freedom of expression, personal responsibility).
Opinion: Strict age-rating systems instead of total bans.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: hành vi bạo lực bắt chước
hệ thống phân loại lứa tuổi

sample:
The influence of violent content in media on societal behavior is a perennially debated issue. While some advocate for strict government bans on violent films and books to protect the public, others argue that such measures infringe upon individual liberties. In my opinion, while total censorship is undesirable, governments should implement rigorous age-rating systems to ensure that vulnerable audiences are protected.

Proponents of government bans argue that violent media can desensitize individuals and contribute to a more aggressive society. They fear that constant exposure to graphic violence in movies and literature might lead to 'copycat' behavior, particularly among those with unstable mental health. From this perspective, the government has a duty to safeguard public morality and safety by restricting content that could potentially incite harm. They believe that the collective well-being of society should take precedence over the creative freedom of a few authors or filmmakers.

On the other hand, many people believe that individuals should have the autonomy to choose their own entertainment. They argue that a government ban constitutes a form of censorship that violates the fundamental right to freedom of expression. Furthermore, most adults are capable of distinguishing between fiction and reality and should be trusted to make their own decisions about what they consume. Banning artistic works can also be a 'slippery slope,' where governments might eventually start suppressing any ideas that they find inconvenient or controversial, under the guise of protecting the public.

In my view, a balanced approach is the most effective. Instead of an outright ban, which is often counterproductive and difficult to enforce in the internet age, the focus should be on education and regulation. Governments should mandate a clear and strict age-rating system that prevents children from accessing inappropriate content. At the same time, parents should be encouraged to take responsibility for their children's media consumption, while adults remain free to explore diverse forms of art and storytelling.

In conclusion, while the concerns about violent media are valid, I believe that individual freedom should be preserved. By focusing on classification and protection for minors rather than total bans, society can balance safety with liberty.

title: Gender Imbalance in TV Sports Coverage
question: Today, TV channels show more men’s sports than women’s sports. Why is this the case? Should TV channels give equal time for women’s sport and men’s sport?
guide:
Chủ đề: Sự chênh lệch thời lượng phát sóng giữa thể thao nam và nữ.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Lợi nhuận (đối tượng xem nam đông), cường độ thi đấu nam cao hơn. Quan điểm: Nên công bằng để thúc đẩy bình đẳng giới và thu nhập cho vận động viên nữ.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons for dominance (commercial viability, viewership demographics, physical intensity of men's sports).
Body 2: Why equality is necessary (promoting gender equality, fair recognition, increasing endorsement opportunities for women).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: tối đa hóa lượt xem và lợi nhuận
sự xuất hiện trên truyền thông

sample:
These days, there is a significant difference between men and women’s sports coverage on television. I believe that women’s sport should get just as much coverage as men’s, and will outline my reasons in the following essay.

To begin with, there are many reasons for the dominance of men's sports programs on television. Due to a large proportion of sports viewers being male, television channels tend to broadcast men's sports programs to maximize their ratings and profits. Take football as an example. Inside a coffee shop, it is common to see a group of young men discussing a recent men’s football match, while women often show a greater preference for discussing other topics like shopping or celebrity gossip. Additionally, because men are usually physically stronger and faster than women, they tend to play at a much higher level, which makes men’s sports much more exciting to watch for many viewers.

However, I am of the opinion that it is necessary for television channels to provide equal sports coverage for both genders. Firstly, it helps to create gender equality in society and increases the participation rate of women in sport. Every time women go out onto the field, they give it their all; therefore, just like men, female athletes should receive full recognition for their effort. Secondly, better media coverage also enables women to make money from endorsements which improves their income. That is to say, more television exposure for female players will lead to major deals with endorsers and higher salaries in the future through advertising contracts.

In conclusion, while the current dominance of men's sports is driven by market demand and physical intensity, I truly believe that it is necessary to ensure equal coverage to foster a fairer and more inclusive sporting culture.

title: Spoken vs Written Communication
question: Spoken communication is more powerful than written communication. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Giao tiếp bằng lời nói có mạnh mẽ hơn văn bản không?
Gợi ý: Đồng ý một phần. Lời nói truyền tải cảm xúc và giải quyết mâu thuẫn nhanh, nhưng văn bản quan trọng trong pháp lý và lưu trữ thông tin chính xác.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Power of spoken communication (emotional connection via tone, immediate feedback/clarification).
Body 2: Power of written communication (formal documentation, legal validity, clarity/re-readability in business).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sự hiểu lầm trong giao tiếp

sample:
Some people believe that speaking is a more powerful form of communication than writing. Personally, I think that both methods are highly effective; however, it simply depends upon the specific circumstance as to which is the most appropriate at the time.

On the one hand, speaking is an extremely effective mode of communication in certain contexts. Oral communication enables people to connect with their listeners on an emotional level. The tone of someone’s voice can powerfully convey a wide range of emotions, which is why some people are able to inspire and influence others simply through a powerful speech or poem. Secondly, misunderstandings can be easily prevented when people interact face to face. For example, if one person is confused about what the other is saying, they can immediately ask for further explanation to ensure that the information being exchanged is completely understood.

On the other hand, writing can also be an indispensable tool in everyday communication. In the workplace, written messages, emails, and documents are effective tools because they provide a permanent record. While speech may sometimes be ignored or misinterpreted, written forms are usually stated very clearly and can be reread repeatedly to avoid miscommunication. Additionally, written documents are usually required in legal matters. This is the reason why many important documents, including contracts, reports, and job descriptions, are kept in written form to ensure accountability.

In conclusion, both spoken and written modes of communication have their own unique purposes and benefits. Choosing the right medium depends on whether the goal is emotional impact or formal accuracy.

title: Digital Technology and Filmmaking
question: Nowadays, it is not only large companies that are able to make films as digital technology enables anyone to produce films. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Công nghệ kỹ thuật số giúp ai cũng có thể làm phim - Tích cực hay tiêu cực?
Gợi ý: Rất tích cực. Nó giải phóng sự sáng tạo, đa dạng hóa nội dung và cho phép truyền bá các vấn đề xã hội quan trọng mà không bị giới hạn bởi lợi nhuận của các hãng lớn.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Benefits for creators (low cost, easy tools like smartphones/apps, pursuit of passion without formal training).
Body 2: Benefits for society (diversity of content, independent documentaries on social issues, breaking the monopoly of big studios).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
Thanks to the advancement of digital technology, it is now possible for almost anyone to make a film. Personally, I think this is a highly positive development for both individual expression and society as a whole.

Firstly, the advancement of personal electronic devices, such as smartphones and digital cameras, has made filmmaking reasonably simple for the average person. This has allowed filmmaking to become a popular hobby and creative outlet for millions worldwide. There are even many apps available that allow people to shoot and edit short films directly on their devices and then upload the content to social media platforms. Furthermore, this accessibility empowers those with a natural talent for filmmaking to follow their dreams and build a career, even if they do not have the opportunity to formally study filmography at a university.

Besides being beneficial for individual creators, this development is also positive for the audience. In recent decades, mainstream Hollywood movies have become repetitive for many people. Thanks to digital technology, independent directors can now produce and release their films to the public via the internet, allowing for a much greater diversity of stories and perspectives. Finally, technology has allowed people to create documentaries about important social issues, such as environmental protection, and publish them online to inform the public about pressing concerns. In the past, what we could watch was limited to what was produced by large companies whose main concern was profit.

In conclusion, although the ease of filmmaking may lead to a higher volume of low-quality content, the benefits of democratic creativity and diverse storytelling far outweigh any drawbacks.

title: Mental vs Physical Strength in Sport
question: Is mental strength important for success in sport or is it more important to be strong and fit for success in sport? Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Sức mạnh tinh thần hay thể chất quan trọng hơn trong thể thao?
Gợi ý: Cả hai đều thiết yếu. Thể chất là nền tảng để thực hiện kỹ thuật, nhưng tinh thần là yếu tố quyết định sự ổn định và thành công ở cấp độ cao nhất.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Importance of physical attributes (strength, speed, coordination, injury recovery).
Body 2: Importance of mental conditioning (focus under pressure, determination to overcome setbacks, composure).
Conclusion: Summary + Opinion (Mental strength is the 'edge' for elite athletes).

vocab.meaning: sự rèn luyện/chuẩn bị tâm lý

sample:
The factors contributing to success in sport are continually being investigated by scientists and athletes alike. While some argue that a person’s physical attributes determine their level of performance, I believe that mental conditioning is equally, if not more, important for long-term success.

On the one hand, it is undeniable that physical characteristics play a major role in sports. In many disciplines, being able to run fast or lift heavy weights is the core requirement. Without a strong physical body and a high level of coordination, an athlete simply cannot compete at a high level. For example, in the 100m sprint, athletes must have powerful leg muscles to generate explosive speed. Similarly, in Olympic weightlifting, success is fundamentally based on having conditioned muscles capable of enduring extreme stress. Furthermore, a fit body recovers much faster from the inevitable injuries that occur in professional sports.

On the other hand, physical strength alone is rarely enough to reach the top. To consistently perform at a very high level, athletes must be mentally strong. Professional sports are filled with setbacks, such as losses and injuries, and only those with the determination and focus to persist can survive. Moreover, being able to mentally concentrate whilst under pressure is crucial during a competition. For instance, maintaining composure while being surrounded by thousands of screaming fans when trying to kick a winning penalty in a football match is a test of mental strength rather than physical power. It is this psychological 'edge' that often separates champions from the rest of the field.

In conclusion, although physical ability is the foundation of sports performance, mental strength and focus play an indispensable role. In my opinion, the most successful athletes are those who master both their bodies and their minds.

title: Rising Consumption of Sugar-Based Drinks
question: People are having more and more sugar-based drinks. What are the reasons? What are the solutions to make people drink less?
guide:
Chủ đề: Sự gia tăng tiêu thụ đồ uống có đường.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Cần năng lượng/sự tỉnh táo cho công việc áp lực, thiếu kiến thức về dinh dưỡng. Giải pháp: Đánh thuế cao, chiến dịch giáo dục về sức khỏe.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (energy boost for demanding jobs, lack of nutritional awareness, dominance of fast food culture).
Body 2: Solutions (sugar tax to raise prices, educational campaigns in schools/media).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sự tỉnh táo về tinh thần

sample:
These days, people are consuming more and more sugar-based drinks, such as soft drinks and energy drinks. The following essay will outline a number of reasons for this issue and several ways to encourage people to reduce their consumption of such drinks.

There are two main reasons why sugar-based drinks are consumed in large amounts every day. Firstly, such drinks provide people with extra energy, increase their mental alertness and help them to maintain high levels of concentration which may be necessary for their job. Most jobs nowadays are becoming more and more demanding and require people to spend greater effort to succeed, consequently leading to the popularity of sugar-based drinks. Secondly, the increased consumption of sugar-based drinks is linked to a lack of awareness and knowledge of a healthy diet and lifestyle, as well as the dominance of fast food in the food industry. That is why sedentary lifestyles and convenient but nutrient-poor meals, which include sugar-based drinks like Coca-Cola or Pepsi, are being favored by a large number of people.

Although reducing the consumption of sugar-based drinks is a complex task, there are a few things that could be done to discourage people from consuming those drinks regularly. One approach is to impose higher taxes on the production and distribution of sugar-based drinks, which would inevitably increase the price of the product. This may have a significant enough effect on the amount of such drinks being consumed. Another strategy is to provide more education to people that encourages them to follow healthy dietary guidelines and lifestyles and refrain from using sugar-based drinks.

In conclusion, the problem of people consuming more and more sugar-based drinks is caused by a number of factors as discussed above. Increasing taxes on sugar-based drinks and running educational campaigns to raise consumers’ awareness of their health are two feasible solutions to combat such problems.

title: Social Media vs Face-to-Face Interaction
question: The use of social media is replacing face-to-face interaction among many people in society. Do you think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
guide:
Chủ đề: Mạng xã hội thay thế giao tiếp trực tiếp.
Gợi ý: Có lợi ích (kết nối toàn cầu, học tập trực tuyến) nhưng tác hại đáng ngại hơn (bắt nạt qua mạng, xói mòn mối quan hệ thực, ảnh hưởng sức khỏe tâm lý).
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Advantages (facilitating global communication, educational access via live streaming).
Body 2: Disadvantages (online harassment/bullying, toxic environment, decline of real-life social skills, mental health issues like loneliness).
Conclusion: Summary + Opinion (Disadvantages are more significant).
sample:
Social media has deeply infiltrated everyone’s life and is believed to be replacing our face-to-face interaction. This situation, although advantageous in certain aspects, is generally a detriment to true human communication in the long run.

On the one hand, there are a number of benefits from using social networks to communicate. Firstly, they facilitate communication in modern times as people can now globally connect with old friends and relatives, or with others who share common interests. For example, Facebook is currently providing service for 2.4 billion users who can choose to connect and interact with anyone they want, regardless of where they are. Secondly, study sessions frequently occur on social networking websites through live streaming services. Therefore, learners around the world now have free access to online classes on such sites.

On the other hand, the disadvantages of social media replacing face-to-face interaction are much more concerning. As these sites are becoming more and more dominant and attract large numbers of new users every day, people can fall prey to online communication abuse, such as online bullying and harassment. Social networking websites can become a toxic environment where users can be verbally abused because there are only a few rules, most of which are spoken rules rather than established guidelines, that restrict hateful or abusive contents. Furthermore, overuse of social media to communicate can lead to people downplaying the importance of face-to-face interaction on which true human relationships thrive. Nowadays, many young and reclusive users prefer living in a virtual world on social sites rather than engaging in real-life relationships. This may have serious mental effects, such as increased stress, anxiety, and loneliness.

In conclusion, the downsides of social media replacing face-to-face interaction are more significant than the benefits users could reap from those sites.

title: Reading Stories vs TV and Computer Games
question: Some people believe that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Đọc truyện vs Xem TV/Chơi game cho trẻ em.
Gợi ý: Hoàn toàn đồng ý. Đọc sách kích thích trí tưởng tượng (vì phải tự hình dung) và phát triển kỹ năng ngôn ngữ tốt hơn các phương tiện nghe nhìn.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Imagination (reading requires visualization vs TV's passive consumption).
Body 2: Language development (exposure to vocabulary/grammar vs focus on sound/images in games).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
Many people believe that reading books is far more beneficial for children than watching television or playing computer games. Personally, I completely agree with this opinion and will analyze the issue in the following essay.

To begin with, children can better improve their imagination through reading books as opposed to watching television or playing computer games. By reading stories, children have to use their imagination to visualize all the events described in the book. While reading, they will create images, thoughts and opinions in their mind, and therefore enhance their imagination and creativity. Meanwhile, this can hardly be the case for watching television, as it already provides the viewers with vibrant colourful images and sounds. Consequently, it is reasonable to say that reading books helps to improve children’s imagination compared to watching television or playing computer games.

Additionally, reading stories from a book also develops children’s verbal abilities more so than watching television or playing computer games. Children are exposed to a wide range of vocabulary and sentence structures when reading, and therefore reading books can provide great opportunities for children to advance their ability to describe things, which leads to better writing skills. Meanwhile, rather than text, sound and image are the two key elements of television and computer games, which does little to improve children’s vocabulary.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that the advantages of reading books far outweigh those of watching television or playing computer games as this activity helps to enhance both imagination and language ability.

title: Impact of Online Shopping on Environment and Jobs
question: Online shopping is increasing dramatically. How could this trend affect our environment and the kinds of jobs required?
guide:
Chủ đề: Tác động của mua sắm trực tuyến.
Gợi ý: Môi trường: Giảm khí thải xe cá nhân (tích cực) nhưng tăng rác thải nhựa (tiêu cực). Việc làm: Tạo nhiều việc làm công nghệ/giao hàng nhưng làm mất việc làm bán lẻ truyền thống.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Environmental impact (Pros: reduced vehicle trips/exhaust fumes via grouped deliveries; Cons: excessive plastic packaging pollution).
Body 2: Labor market impact (Pros: demand for IT, web design, logistics; Cons: decline of brick-and-mortar retail, unemployment for traditional clerks).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
In recent years, online shopping has gained more and more popularity all over the world. This tendency has several impacts on the environment and on various jobs related to e-commerce.

The rise of online shopping is both beneficial and harmful to the environment to some extent. One obvious benefit of this trend is that it can help reduce the number of vehicles travelling to brick-and-mortar stores, since customer orders from similar locations can be grouped together and delivered to homes at the same time. This will eventually lessen a great deal of exhaust fumes released into the atmosphere, which is one of the main causes of air pollution nowadays. However, if people are encouraged to shop online more often, more plastic waste will be released into the environment, especially water bodies such as rivers and oceans. As a consequence, this will harm natural habitats of numerous marine species and worsen the problem of environmental pollution.

The growth of e-commerce has also brought both negative and positive impacts on employment. On the one hand, this trend has created a variety of work opportunities for people, especially for those who major in information technology. To maintain an online store, there will be a need for many kinds of jobs such as database administrators, web designers, delivery drivers, and so on. On the other hand, as e-commerce becomes more and more popular, an increasing number of people working at traditional retail stores might lose their jobs and face unemployment. This will place a huge burden on the government to create alternative jobs for these individuals, which might take a long time and require a large amount of tax-payer’s money.

In conclusion, online shopping impacts the environment and the labour market in both positive and negative ways.

title: Job Satisfaction vs Job Security
question: Some people argue job satisfaction is more important than job security. Others believe a permanent job is more important. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Sự hài lòng trong công việc vs Sự ổn định.
Gợi ý: Ổn định (Security): Giúp kiểm soát tài chính, tăng uy tín với sếp. Hài lòng (Satisfaction): Tăng năng suất, giảm áp lực/kiệt sức, giữ chân nhân tài.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Importance of job security (financial control, long-term planning, building trust/credibility with employers).
Body 2: Importance of job satisfaction (fulfilling needs/desires, boosting morale/productivity, reducing turnover rates for companies).
Conclusion: Summary + Opinion (Satisfaction is more important for long-term commitment).

vocab.meaning: sự gắn bó với tổ chức
áp lực công việc và sự kiệt sức

sample:
While some people say job satisfaction is more essential than job security, there are those who claim that a permanent job is of greater significance. This essay discusses both sides of the argument and why I believe job satisfaction plays a more important role than job security.

On the one hand, some people believe a permanent job is more important because of the stability and credibility it brings. In terms of finance, workers with a permanent job know their exact monthly income, and thus are in full control of their financial plan. As a consequence, they will no longer have to worry about short-term financial problems, such as bills and debts, and can focus on other important matters like their career path. In addition, staying loyal to one job results in higher credibility, as many employers view prioritizing job security as an indicator of organizational commitment. Gaining the trust of the employer opens many opportunities for promotion and additional perks, be it bonuses or extra days off.

On the other hand, there are several reasons why job satisfaction is believed to be more important than job security. A worker gains satisfaction when his needs and desires are fulfilled. For example, Google provides a gym, climbing walls, and video gaming machines in most of its offices to suit the different needs and desires of its employees. Once satisfied, workers are less likely to suffer from work stress or burnout, enhancing productivity and employee morale. As for employers, keeping their employees satisfied is an effective way to reduce turnover rate. A person who is satisfied with their job is less likely to be job seeking, and making it easier for companies to recruit and retain talented employees.

In conclusion, while some people believe job security plays a more significant role because of financial stability and work credibility, I believe the importance of job satisfaction exceeds that of job security, as satisfied employees are more likely to be more productive and committed to the organization.

title: Relevance and Utility of the News
question: Some people think news has no connection to people’s lives. So then it is a waste of time to read the newspaper and watch television news programs. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Tin tức có vô dụng và tốn thời gian không?
Gợi ý: Đồng ý một phần. Tin tức thực sự có kết nối (sở thích cá nhân, kinh tế, thể thao), nhưng phần lớn tin tức giật gân hiện nay tốn thời gian và không giúp ích cho việc ra quyết định thực tế.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Connection to life (news categorized by interests like business/sports, serving as a 'glue' between events and individuals).
Body 2: Why it can be a waste of time (low impact on personal decision-making, focus on sensational/shocking content, consumption of time without utility).
Conclusion: Summary + Opinion (Agree that much news consumption is pointless despite its relevance).
sample:
It is argued that there is no use in reading newspapers and watching news programs on television because news is irrelevant to people’s daily lives. From my perspective, I somewhat agree with this point of view because although I believe there is a connection between news and people’s lives, reading newspapers and watching news on television is pointless.

To begin with, I disagree that news does not have any connection to everyday life. By definition, the news is information about important current events and is often categorized into different topics, each of which will attract a certain type of audience. For example, sports-minded people will be interested in reading sports news, while businessmen will be more concerned with economic news. In other words, people’s interest in various fields will always be the glue that links news with people’s lives no matter what.

Although the news is connected to people’s lives, I do believe that reading newspapers or watching television news programs is a waste of time. We can read thousands of articles every day, yet very few of them help us make better decisions for our life, business or career. For example, weather forecasts and political news do not affect most of us. In addition, news programs produce news in a way that captures the attention of viewers since the human brain reacts disproportionately to different types of information. Scandalous, shocking or people-based news, which often hold little value to people’s lives, stimulates us and consumes a large amount of our time though we barely learn anything useful from it.

In conclusion, I disagree with claims that news has no connection to people’s lives because news programs report what people are interested in. However, I firmly agree that reading the news is a waste of time since it does not help people make better decisions in their daily lives and the media is biasing a large amount of unhelpful news.

title: Pros and Cons of Personal Advertisements
question: Nowadays, more and more people are using personal advertisements to find a partner. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
guide:
Chủ đề: Sử dụng quảng cáo cá nhân (hẹn hò qua mạng) để tìm đối tác.
Gợi ý: Ưu điểm: Mở rộng cơ hội cho người bận rộn, lọc được người phù hợp nhanh. Nhược điểm: Nguy cơ lừa đảo, thiếu sự kết nối thực tế lúc đầu, thông tin giả mạo.
