These days, a growing number of recruiters are targeting applicants with good people skills as many people believe that they are just as important as formal qualifications. In my opinion, I firmly agree that possessing good social skills, apart from academic skills, can give people an edge in advancing their career.

Undeniably, formal qualifications play a critical role in one’s career because they are generally good indicators of a person’s capability and specialized knowledge. In fact, all employers treasure the intellectual power of their employees, as it is a valuable asset that can help a company thrive. This is particularly true for works that involve in-depth research and development such as information technology, computer science, and medicine. Without technical knowledge, a person stands little chance of being hired, let alone getting a promotion.

However, having only stellar credentials does not always guarantee one’s career success. In this modern society, people rarely work individually and often need to rely on others to get the best result. For that reason, people who have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate are more likely to build good relations with their colleagues and perform better at work. In contrast, those who lack such critical skills may suffer from isolation or miscommunication and trigger conflict among workers, hindering the overall working process. In short, people who possess good communication skills can often gain the love and trust of their co-workers, and stand a higher chance of climbing the career ladder.

In conclusion, I believe that social skills have a strong correlation with career success as they can not only help a person integrate but also facilitate their working process.

title: Overworking: Reasons and Impacts
question: In many countries, people are spending more hours at their workplace. Why is that? Is that a negative and positive development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Xu hướng làm việc nhiều giờ hơn.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Chi phí sinh hoạt tăng cao, sự cạnh tranh gay gắt trong sự nghiệp. Đánh giá: Tiêu cực vì ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến sức khỏe (stress, kiệt sức) và làm xói mòn các mối quan hệ gia đình.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (escalating living costs, intense job competition, desire for rapid professional growth).
Body 2: Evaluation (Negative: health deterioration, lack of work-life balance, strain on family relationships, risk of burnout).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: chi phí sinh hoạt tăng cao
sự cân bằng công việc - cuộc sống

sample:
Spending extra hours at work is becoming more common in recent years. This phenomenon may stem from people’s need for higher wage and their increasing workload, and I firmly believe that this trend is bringing more cons than pros. 

Nowadays, a lot of people are overworking due to the pressure from daily necessities and work. In many cities, due to the escalating living cost, people are made to work extra hours to afford lives. In other words, overworking now is not an option but rather an obligation for many people to survive. In some other cases, people choose to work overtime to cope with their increasing workload. In the modern age, as competition at work is becoming more intense than ever, many people feel an urge to push themselves harder and work longer hours to finish their work, believing that taking on more responsibilities can help them and their organizations thrive.

However, I hold a conviction that this tendency is bringing more harm than good. It is undeniable that earning more money will facilitate one’s life; such a schedule, nevertheless, will put a person under immense pressure, which can make his health deteriorate and cause stress-related illnesses. In a sense, working extra hours will financially benefit people at the cost of their mental and physical health. On the other hand, overworking can accelerate one’s professional growth, however, will leave them little time for themselves and their families. They are less likely to gain work-life balance and will risk the well-being of their close relationships, exposing them to depression and isolation in the future.

In conclusion, while it is understandable why people are spending more time at work, I believe that the merits it brings are not worth the price one needs to pay.

title: Space Exploration Funding
question: Some people think the money spent on developing the technology for space exploration is not justified. There are more beneficial ways to spend this money. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Có nên chi tiền cho khám phá vũ trụ?
Gợi ý: Đồng ý là nên ưu tiên các vấn đề khác. Tiền nên được dùng để giải quyết các thảm họa môi trường và xóa đói giảm nghèo/cải thiện y tế trên trái đất trước khi tìm kiếm sự sống ngoài không gian.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Agree).
Body 1: Environmental priority (climate change, pollution, restoring the planet's health for future generations).
Body 2: Humanitarian priority (poverty, hunger, basic housing, and healthcare for the disadvantaged).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: thảm họa môi trường toàn cầu

sample:
Some people believe that there are far better ways to spend the money that is allocated to space exploration. I completely agree with this statement and feel that protecting the environment and ensuring that every person on earth has a decent standard of living are far more important issues that need addressing.

Firstly, not all countries have space exploration programs. Only countries with huge economies, such as America, Russia, China, and Japan, can afford to fund such programs. However, the money that is spent on these programs is considerably large and could be far better used for other purposes, in particular, addressing environmental issues. It is undeniable that humans are polluting the planet and destroying the environment at a rapid rate, and there seems to be no real action in place to prevent a global environmental catastrophe from occurring in the near future. The billions of dollars that are being spent on space exploration every year could be used to fund programs aimed at restoring the environment so that future generations have a healthy and safe planet to live on.

Furthermore, while there are millions of people around the world who do not have enough food to eat each day or a decent home to live in, spending billions of dollars on space exploration programs seems to be ludicrous. Instead, these billions of dollars could make a huge difference in the lives of millions by funding programs designed to help educate, feed, and house the disadvantaged, impoverished, and sick people in the world, which would be far more significant than the benefits that may be acquired from space exploration. We could spend billions of dollars and many years exploring space but gain nothing from it, while in the same period of time that money could improve the lives of millions of people.

In conclusion, I believe that although there may be some benefit in space exploration, until the issues of the environment and poverty on the planet are completely addressed, funding for space exploration should be absolutely minimised.

title: National vs International News
question: Some people focus on news in their country, while others think it is more important to be aware of international news. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Tin tức trong nước hay quốc tế quan trọng hơn?
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Tin quốc tế giúp hiểu các vấn đề toàn cầu (dịch bệnh, khí hậu). Tin trong nước giúp ích trực tiếp cho cuộc sống (thị trường việc làm, chính trị địa phương, các quyết định cá nhân).
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: International news (global awareness of pandemics, climate change, international relations).
View 2: National news (job market updates, local politics/elections, safety/security in one's own area).
Opinion: National news is often more practically relevant for daily life decisions.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: những điều chỉnh tương ứng kịp thời

sample:
People hold widely differing views on whether following domestic news or world news is more important. Although it is true that concentrating on news from all over the world is beneficial to some extent, I would argue that keeping abreast of national news is a wiser choice.

On the one hand, it is undeniable that being aware of international news has certain benefits. To begin with, following international news can keep people up-to-date with information about global environmental issues. For example, this type of news often provides people with up-to-the-minute reports about the harmful effects of climate change. Therefore, they would realize the urgency of the current environmental situation, thereby taking actions to improve it. Furthermore, if people prefer world news, they can be well-informed about global pandemics. As a result, preventive measures could be promptly taken to prevent deadly diseases from spreading further. 

On the other hand, I believe that national news is of greater importance for a number of reasons. The first one is that since this kind of news can keep people informed about any changes in the job market in their country, they would be able to make timely corresponding adjustments to their skills and knowledge. Thus, it would be easier for them to find a suitable and promising career path, which could lead to a happier life in general. Additionally, focusing on domestic news would help people to be more aware of events relating to national politics that may have a direct impact on their lives. To illustrate, when people have sufficient information about presidential candidates in the upcoming election, they would know who they should cast their vote for, which is an important decision as the future of their country depends on it.

In conclusion, while I acknowledge the importance of keeping up with what is happening around the world, I am still of the opinion that domestic news should be paid more attention to.

title: School Ability Grouping vs Mixed Ability
question: Some people think that schools should choose students according to their academic abilities, while others think it is better to have students of different abilities studying together. Discuss both views and state your own opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Chia lớp theo học lực hay lớp hỗn hợp?
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Lớp hỗn hợp giúp học sinh học hỏi lẫn nhau (người giỏi giúp người yếu) và phát triển kỹ năng xã hội. Lớp theo học lực giúp giáo viên thiết kế bài giảng phù hợp tốc độ (người giỏi học nâng cao, người yếu học chậm kỹ).
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Mixed-ability (peer-to-peer learning, empathy, teamwork, well-rounded development).
View 2: Streaming/Ability grouping (curriculum customization, teacher efficiency, avoiding boredom for fast learners).
Opinion: Ability grouping is often more efficient for academic progress.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: lớp học có nhiều trình độ khác nhau
những cá nhân phát triển toàn diện

sample:
People hold widely differing views on whether schools should put their students into mixed-ability classes or stream them based on their academic abilities. Although it is true that mixing students with different abilities together in a class has certain benefits, I would argue that selecting students on the basis of their academic abilities is a wiser choice.

On the one hand, it is undeniable that mixed-ability classes bring about a number of benefits to students development. To begin with, when students with different abilities are educated together, they would be able to learn from each other and overcome their weaknesses. For instance, those who excel at science subjects but struggle with art subjects can improve their singing or painting skills with the help of their classmates and vice versa. As a result, they may grow up to become more well-rounded individuals. Another benefit that is drawn from this situation is that these children are encouraged to cooperate, thereby improving their teamwork skills, which can be useful in their future career.

On the other hand, I believe that grouping students according to their academic ability is more beneficial to teachers and their students. As intelligent students are separated from weaker students, teachers can easily plan more suitable lessons to work at the right speed for them. For example, students with a high academic ability can be provided with more advanced materials to progress faster, whereas those in a lower level group can acquire knowledge easier when their teachers explain the lesson to them at a slower pace. Therefore, this practice not only helps students to study effectively and efficiently but it also makes teaching easier for teachers.

In conclusion, while mixed-ability classes are advantageous for students’ all-round development, I am still of the opinion that schools should separate students based on their academic abilities for the sake of both teachers and students.

title: Food Waste: Causes and Solutions
question: Nowadays people waste a lot of food that was bought from shops and restaurants. Why do you think people waste food? What can be done to reduce the amount of food they throw away?
guide:
Chủ đề: Lãng phí thức ăn.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Giá thực phẩm rẻ (do công nghệ), mua sắm không kế hoạch (bốc đồng). Giải pháp: Phạt tiền khi bỏ thừa thức ăn (nhà hàng), lập danh sách trước khi đi chợ.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Causes (industrial farming lowering costs, lack of meal planning leading to impulse buying).
Body 2: Solutions (economic penalties in restaurants, public awareness on shopping habits, effective storage techniques).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: công nghệ nông nghiệp tiên tiến
áp đặt một mức phạt nặng

sample:
These days, a great amount of food bought from shops and restaurants is being thrown away irresponsibly. This situation is occurring due to a number of reasons, and there are several feasible solutions that could be adopted to mitigate this problem.

There are two major reasons why food is being wasted. To begin with, thanks to advanced agricultural technologies, farming has become increasingly mechanised, which accelerates production and helps to maximize harvests. At the same time, the way food is transported, stored and distributed has also become more and more streamlined than ever before. As a result, the price of food in shops and restaurants has reduced significantly, making it all the easier for consumers to purchase large quantities of food, and waste it without a second thought. Another reason for this situation is because consumers are failing to make a detailed plan of what they are going to buy before they shop. Consequently, their shopping carts are often full of food products that they might never use.

Some effective measures could be implemented to alleviate this situation. The first solution would be for restaurants to make their customers think twice about what dishes they are going to order. This can be done by imposing a heavy fine on diners who order too many dishes but cannot finish them. Another feasible solution is that people should develop a habit of making a list of ingredients and foodstuffs that they really need before going shopping. This would help consumers to have time to prepare carefully and decide wisely what food items should be bought, which would prevent a great deal of food from being thrown away. 

In conclusion, increasingly cheaper food products and poor meal planning are two primary reasons contributing to the huge amount of food waste occurring these days. Fortunately, there are various effective solutions to tackle this issue, including penalizing restaurant customers who waste food and making detailed shopping lists.

title: Increasing Use of Cars: Reasons and Control
question: Although it is widely recognized that cars damage the environment, their manufacture and use continue to increase. Why is this the case? How could this increase be controlled?
guide:
Chủ đề: Tăng trưởng ô tô bất chấp hại môi trường.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Tiện lợi và hiệu quả nhất hiện nay, đóng góp lớn cho kinh tế/thuế. Giải pháp: Thúc đẩy xe điện, đầu tư hạ tầng xe đạp, cải thiện giao thông công cộng.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (unmatched convenience, economic importance/jobs/taxes, slow adoption of affordable alternatives).
Body 2: Solutions (subsidies for clean energy vehicles, designated safe cycling zones, robust public transit infrastructure).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: xe sử dụng động cơ đốt trong
tạo ra hàng triệu tiền thuế

sample:
Across the globe, the automobile industry is booming, despite the fact that many people believe cars are damaging the environment. The following essay will discuss why this is occurring and what can be done to control the situation.

Cars continue to be manufactured these days because they are the most popular, comfortable, and efficient form of transportation that is available to most people. If there were a better option that was more affordable, more efficient, and more widely available, then the majority of people would obviously choose it. Although electric and hybrid cars are now becoming increasingly more common, they are not currently as affordable or as available as normal combustion engine vehicles. Furthermore, the automotive and petroleum industries are multi-billion dollar industries in many countries around the world and provide millions of jobs for people and generate millions of dollars in taxes for governments, and therefore shutting those industries down would be a difficult process.

However, there are some strategies that could be implemented to try to control this issue. Firstly, governments can try to promote the use and manufacture of electric vehicles and other modes of transport that do not burn fossil fuels. Governments could fund further research and design of electric automobiles that harness energy from the sun or that use other alternative forms of energy that do not pollute the earth. Governments can also encourage citizens to use bicycles more often by providing safe cycling zones on roadways, to minimise the risk of accidents with automobiles. Lastly, governments must increase the public transportation infrastructure in their countries and encourage citizens to use it more often by making it cheap and efficient.

In conclusion, the main reasons that people continue to use cars is simply because it is the best option currently available for those who can afford them, and because the automobile and petroleum industries are so huge that it would cause many problems to simply dispose of them.

title: Government Spending Priority: Elderly vs Youth
question: Some people believe that the care of elderly people should be a priority of government spending. Others believe that government spending should focus more on young people, especially on their education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Chính phủ nên ưu tiên chi tiền cho người già hay trẻ em?
Gợi ý: Cả hai đều quan trọng. Người già xứng đáng được chăm sóc vì những cống hiến quá khứ. Trẻ em cần giáo dục để là tương lai của đất nước. Giải pháp là cân bằng ngân sách và yêu cầu trách nhiệm từ gia đình.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Focus on Elderly (reward for lifelong contribution, basic human welfare, medical needs).
View 2: Focus on Youth (future of economy, long-term national development, social mobility through education).
Opinion: Both are essential; families must also share the burden to relieve state pressure.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: xương sống của nền kinh tế

vocab.word: take a large proportion of responsibility
vocab.meaning: đảm nhận phần lớn trách nhiệm

sample:
While some people believe that governments should make the care of the elderly generation a priority, others feel that it is the youth and their education that should be prioritised. I believe that both aspects of society deserve an equal amount of attention from governments, however families must also take a large proportion of responsibility for both these issues.

Firstly, governments most definitely need to provide a certain level of care for the elderly generation of their country. These are the people who spent their lives helping build their country and its economy to make it a better place for those who come after them. Without the hard work of those citizens, the country would not be where it is today, and therefore they should be taken care of to a certain extent, including free healthcare and discounted medicine. However, families must also take responsibility for the care of the elderly, as the government cannot be fully responsible for every old person. Just as parents care for and nurture their young when they are helpless, adult children must also care for their parents and grandparents when they are old, sick, and dying.

On the other hand, the needs of the younger generation of a country are just as important as those of the elderly, as they will be the backbone of a country’s future economy. Education is the key to a country’s success, and therefore the education of the youth should definitely be a priority for every government. If a country fails to educate its youth, then the future of that country and its economy is at great risk. Again, families must also take a large proportion of responsibility here by providing the right environment at home to nurture their children so they can excel in their education.

In conclusion, I believe that the needs of both the elderly and the youth are equally important and should both be a priority for governments, however families must also take a certain amount of responsibility for both of these aspects of society.

title: Art vs Science Funding
question: Some people think that the government should spend more money on arts and culture. Others believe that the money should be spent on more important things like health and education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Chi tiền cho nghệ thuật hay y tế/giáo dục?
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Y tế/giáo dục là nền tảng sinh tồn và phát triển kinh tế. Nghệ thuật là linh hồn của dân tộc, giúp giải trí và thúc đẩy du lịch. Giải pháp là cân bằng ngân sách tùy theo giai đoạn phát triển quốc gia.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Arts and Culture (national identity, historical preservation, tourism revenue, mental well-being).
View 2: Health and Education (fundamental human needs, workforce productivity, poverty reduction, scientific progress).
Opinion: Essential services must be secured first, but arts shouldn't be neglected as they provide quality of life.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: nhu cầu cơ bản của con người

sample:
While some argue that arts and culture deserve a larger share of government funding, others contend that essential services like healthcare and education should take precedence. In my view, while the primary focus must be on fundamental public services, the arts should not be entirely overlooked as they are vital to a nation’s spirit and economy.

On the one hand, proponents of art funding argue that it is the cornerstone of national identity. Art galleries, museums, and cultural festivals preserve a country's history and heritage for future generations. Furthermore, the arts are a significant driver of tourism, attracting millions of international visitors and generating substantial revenue. For example, cities like Paris or Florence thrive economically primarily due to their cultural assets. From a social perspective, engaging with the arts provides people with emotional enrichment and a creative outlet, which are essential for mental well-being in a fast-paced modern world.

On the other hand, many believe that health and education are more pressing concerns. A well-funded healthcare system ensures a healthy workforce, which is directly linked to a country's economic productivity. Similarly, education is the most powerful tool for social mobility and poverty reduction. Without adequate investment in schools and hospitals, a society faces long-term risks such as labor shortages and widespread inequality. Many argue that until every citizen has access to basic medical care and quality schooling, spending on luxuries like opera houses or abstract art installations is hard to justify.

In conclusion, although health and education are undoubtedly the primary responsibilities of any government, I believe that arts and culture also play a necessary role. A balanced approach where essential needs are met first, followed by support for the arts, will create a society that is both physically healthy and culturally rich.

title: Urban Migration: Problems and Solutions
question: In many countries, more and more people are moving to cities. What are the problems associated with this? What can be done to solve these problems?
guide:
Chủ đề: Di dân ra thành phố.
Gợi ý: Vấn đề: Quá tải hạ tầng (tắc đường, thiếu nhà), ô nhiễm môi trường, thất nghiệp ở nông thôn. Giải pháp: Phát triển kinh tế vùng ven, cải thiện tiện nghi ở nông thôn, xây dựng thành phố vệ tinh.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Problems (Infrastructure strain, housing shortages, traffic congestion, urban pollution, labor drains in rural areas).
Body 2: Solutions (Regional development, relocating industries to outskirts, improving rural amenities, satellite city construction).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
The rapid migration of people from rural areas to urban centers is a global phenomenon. While cities offer more opportunities, this trend leads to significant challenges that require strategic intervention from governments.

One major problem associated with urban migration is the immense strain on infrastructure. As the population in cities grows beyond their capacity, public services such as transportation and sanitation become overwhelmed, leading to chronic traffic congestion and inadequate waste management. Furthermore, the high demand for housing drives up property prices, forcing many low-income families to live in overcrowded slums or informal settlements. Additionally, the influx of workers can lead to higher competition for jobs, potentially increasing the rate of urban poverty and crime. Meanwhile, rural areas suffer from a 'brain drain' as their youngest and most capable residents leave, hindering agricultural and regional development.

To address these issues, several measures can be taken. Firstly, governments should invest in regional development to create jobs and improve living standards in rural areas. By offering tax incentives to companies that relocate their offices or factories to the countryside, the authorities can provide local employment opportunities, reducing the need for people to migrate. Secondly, improving rural amenities such as hospitals, schools, and high-speed internet can make life in small towns more attractive. Lastly, the construction of satellite cities—planned urban areas on the outskirts of major metropolises—can help redistribute the population and alleviate the pressure on city centers.

In conclusion, while urban migration poses serious threats to infrastructure and social stability, these problems can be mitigated through decentralized economic planning and the enhancement of rural infrastructure.

title: The Importance of Music and Culture
question: Music is a traditional part of many cultures. Some people think music is as important as other arts, while others believe that it is not that important. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Vai trò của âm nhạc.
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Một số người coi âm nhạc chỉ là giải trí nhất thời. Nhưng thực tế, âm nhạc là phương tiện truyền tải lịch sử, gắn kết cộng đồng và có tác dụng chữa lành tâm hồn/giảm stress cực tốt.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Music is less important (temporary entertainment, lack of visual permanence compared to painting/architecture).
View 2: Music is vital (cultural storytelling, emotional connection, universal language, therapeutic benefits).
Opinion: Music is arguably the most accessible and influential art form.
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
Music has been an integral part of human civilization since ancient times. While some view it as a mere form of fleeting entertainment, others argue that its cultural and social significance is equal to or even greater than other art forms. I believe that music is a vital art form that serves as a universal language and a source of profound emotional healing.

On the one hand, those who downplay the importance of music often contrast it with visual arts like painting or architecture. They argue that while a statue or a building provides a permanent physical record of a culture, music is ethereal and temporary. From this perspective, music is seen primarily as a background element to daily life—something to be enjoyed during leisure time but not essential for the survival or progress of a society. Furthermore, in an increasingly commercialized world, much of modern music is produced for mass consumption, leading to the perception that it lacks the depth and craftsmanship of 'high arts.'

On the other hand, music is widely regarded as a fundamental pillar of cultural identity. Traditional songs and melodies carry the history, values, and stories of a people through generations, often surviving even when physical artifacts are destroyed. Unlike visual arts, music has a unique emotional resonance that can transcend language barriers, allowing people from different backgrounds to connect and empathize with one another. Additionally, the therapeutic benefits of music are well-documented; it has the power to reduce stress, improve mental health, and even aid in cognitive development in children. In many cultures, music is inseparable from social rituals, such as weddings and religious ceremonies, proving its essential role in communal life.

In conclusion, while music may seem less 'solid' than other art forms, its impact on the human psyche and cultural preservation is immeasurable. I believe it is a primary art form that enriches our lives in ways that visual or literary arts cannot replicate.

title: Online Shopping: Merits and Drawbacks
question: The increase in online shopping will lead to the disappearance of many local shops. Is this a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Mua sắm trực tuyến làm biến mất cửa hàng địa phương.
Gợi ý: Tiêu cực. Dù online shopping tiện lợi và rẻ hơn, nhưng việc mất các cửa hàng truyền thống gây thất nghiệp, làm mất đi sự tương tác xã hội và biến các khu phố thành 'thành phố ma'.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Negative).
Body 1: Advantages of online shopping (Convenience, 24/7 access, price comparison, wide variety).
Body 2: Why the loss of local shops is negative (Economic impact: local job losses; Social impact: loss of community interaction and vibrant streets; consumer experience: unable to touch/try products).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sự tiện lợi không thể đánh bại

sample:
The rise of e-commerce has fundamentally changed the retail landscape, with many traditional brick-and-mortar stores struggling to survive. While online shopping offers undeniable benefits, I believe that the disappearance of local shops is a predominantly negative development for communities and local economies.

On the positive side, online shopping provides unbeatable convenience. Consumers can browse thousands of products from the comfort of their homes, compare prices across different platforms instantly, and have items delivered to their doorstep. This is particularly beneficial for busy professionals and people living in remote areas with limited access to physical stores. Furthermore, the lower overhead costs of online retailers often result in cheaper prices for consumers, making goods more accessible to a wider range of people. The efficiency of digital transactions has undoubtedly streamlined the way we consume goods.

However, the decline of local shops has serious social and economic repercussions. Firstly, local businesses are significant employers in many communities. Their closure leads to widespread job losses, particularly for students and low-skilled workers. Secondly, physical shops are not just commercial entities; they are social hubs where neighbors interact, contributing to the sense of community. A street filled with shuttered storefronts loses its character and can become a magnet for crime, leading to urban decay. Finally, many products, such as clothing or fresh produce, are better evaluated in person. The loss of physical stores deprives consumers of the ability to inspect quality or receive immediate personal advice from staff.

In conclusion, although the growth of online retail reflects technological progress, the resulting loss of local shops is a regrettable trend. Governments should find ways to support small businesses to ensure that our streets remain vibrant and our local economies stay resilient.

title: Reliability of News Sources
question: Nowadays many people get their news from the internet. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Đọc tin tức trên mạng.
Gợi ý: Cả hai (Balanced). Tích cực: Tốc độ nhanh, đa dạng nguồn, miễn phí. Tiêu cực: Tin giả (fake news), thiếu kiểm duyệt chuyên môn, thuật toán tạo ra 'phòng vang' (echo chambers).
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Both positive and negative).
Body 1: Positive aspects (Immediacy, accessibility, diverse perspectives from citizen journalism, environmentally friendly/paperless).
Body 2: Negative aspects (Spread of misinformation/fake news, lack of editorial oversight, sensationalism, echo chambers).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sự tức thời của thông tin

sample:
The internet has surpassed traditional newspapers and television as the primary source of news for millions. While this shift offers unprecedented access to information, I believe it is a double-edged sword that presents significant risks alongside its benefits.

One clear advantage of online news is the immediacy of information. In the past, people had to wait for the morning paper or the evening broadcast to learn about world events. Today, breaking news is published in real-time, often accompanied by live video feeds. Furthermore, the internet democratizes news by allowing diverse voices—from independent bloggers to eyewitnesses—to share their perspectives, providing a broader view than traditional media conglomerates might offer. Additionally, the move to digital news is more environmentally friendly as it reduces the need for paper production and physical distribution.

However, the lack of editorial oversight on many digital platforms is a major drawback. Unlike traditional news organizations that follow strict journalistic codes and fact-checking procedures, many online sources prioritize speed and clicks over accuracy. This has led to the rampant spread of misinformation and 'fake news,' which can manipulate public opinion and cause social division. Moreover, social media algorithms often show users news that aligns with their existing beliefs, creating 'echo chambers' where people are never exposed to opposing viewpoints. This polarization can be damaging to the healthy functioning of a democratic society.

In conclusion, the migration of news to the internet is a positive development in terms of speed and accessibility, but it requires consumers to be more critical and media-literate than ever before. To mitigate the negatives, users must verify sources and seek out balanced reporting rather than relying on unverified social media updates.

title: Working from Home: Merits and Drawbacks
question: In many countries, an increasing number of people are choosing to work from home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
guide:
Chủ đề: Làm việc tại nhà.
Gợi ý: Ưu điểm: Tiết kiệm thời gian/chi phí đi lại, linh hoạt giờ giấc, giảm ô nhiễm. Nhược điểm: Thiếu tương tác trực tiếp, khó phân định công việc - đời sống, nguy cơ xao nhãng và cô đơn.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Advantages (Elimination of commuting, cost savings on fuel/transport, flexible schedule, better work-life balance for parents, environmental benefits).
Body 2: Disadvantages (Professional isolation, lack of face-to-face collaboration, difficulty in separating work from home life, household distractions, potential for overworking).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: loại bỏ việc đi lại đi làm
sự cô lập trong nghề nghiệp
sự xao nhãng từ việc nhà

sample:
Advances in technology have made remote work a viable option for a growing portion of the global workforce. While working from home offers significant flexibility and cost savings, it also presents challenges related to social isolation and personal discipline.

The primary advantage of working from home is the elimination of commuting. By removing the need to travel to an office every day, employees can save hours of time and substantial amounts of money on fuel or public transport. This extra time can be redirected toward exercise, family, or personal hobbies, leading to a higher quality of life. Furthermore, a home-based setup allows for a more flexible schedule, which is particularly beneficial for parents who need to balance work with childcare duties. From an environmental perspective, fewer commuters mean reduced traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions in major cities.

On the other hand, remote work can lead to a sense of professional and social isolation. The lack of face-to-face interaction with colleagues can hinder effective communication and the spontaneous collaboration that often leads to innovation. Moreover, many people find it difficult to maintain a clear boundary between their professional and private lives when both occur in the same space. Without the structure of an office environment, employees may succumb to household distractions or, conversely, find themselves working late into the night because they never truly 'leave' their workplace. Finally, some workers may miss out on mentorship opportunities and the social camaraderie that traditional offices provide.

In conclusion, the trend toward working from home is a logical response to the digital age, offering great convenience and environmental benefits. However, to be successful, both employers and employees must implement strategies to maintain social connections and establish healthy work-life boundaries.

title: Advertising Influence on Consumers
question: Some people think that advertising is good for the economy, while others think that it is bad because it encourages people to buy things they do not need. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Tác động của quảng cáo.
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Quảng cáo thúc đẩy tiêu dùng, tạo việc làm và tài trợ cho truyền thông miễn phí. Tuy nhiên, nó cũng dùng tâm lý học để lôi kéo người ta mua sắm bốc đồng, gây nợ nần và lối sống lãng phí.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Economic benefits (stimulates demand, funds free media, creates jobs in marketing/creative sectors, informs consumers of choices).
View 2: Negative impacts (manipulative tactics, encouraging materialism, creating artificial needs, leading to consumer debt).
Opinion: Advertising is necessary for a market economy but needs stricter regulations to protect vulnerable consumers.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: nhu cầu nhân tạo/không thực tế

sample:
Advertising is a pervasive force in modern society, sparking debate over its true value. While some argue that it is a vital engine for economic growth, others criticize it for fostering a culture of mindless consumerism. I believe that while advertising is economically essential, its manipulative nature requires consumers to be vigilant.

On the one hand, advertising is a primary driver of a market economy. By informing the public about new products and services, it stimulates demand, which in turn leads to increased production and job creation. Furthermore, advertising revenue is the lifeblood of the media industry; without it, many news outlets, social media platforms, and entertainment services would be unable to provide free content to the public. It also encourages competition among companies, often leading to better product quality and lower prices as brands strive to win over consumers. For a business, advertising is the most effective tool to reach its target audience and ensure its survival.

On the other hand, critics point out the psychological manipulation inherent in modern marketing. Many advertisements are designed to create artificial needs by associating products with success, beauty, or happiness. This can lead people to buy items they do not truly require or can ill afford, resulting in personal debt and environmental waste. For instance, the fast fashion industry uses aggressive advertising to convince consumers that their current wardrobe is 'out of date,' leading to a cycle of constant and unnecessary purchasing. Moreover, children are particularly vulnerable to these tactics, as they may lack the critical thinking skills to distinguish between information and persuasion.

In conclusion, advertising plays an indispensable role in maintaining a healthy economy and supporting free media. However, because it can encourage irresponsible spending and materialism, it should be balanced with consumer education and ethical regulations to ensure it remains a tool for information rather than manipulation.

title: Living Alone: Merits and Drawbacks
question: In many countries, more and more people are living alone. Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Sống một mình.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Sự độc lập về tài chính (đặc biệt là phụ nữ), xu hướng kết hôn muộn, đô thị hóa. Đánh giá: Cả hai. Tích cực: Tự do cá nhân, trưởng thành. Tiêu cực: Cô đơn, chi phí sinh hoạt cao hơn, gánh nặng cho hệ thống chăm sóc người già.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (Financial independence, delayed marriage, focus on career, urbanization making one-person apartments more common).
Body 2: Evaluation (Positive: autonomy, self-reliance. Negative: loneliness/depression, higher living costs per person, social fragmentation).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
The number of one-person households has seen a significant increase in many developed nations. This shift is driven by economic independence and changing social values, and while it empowers individuals, it also poses risks to mental health and social cohesion.

A primary reason for the rise in solo living is the increase in financial independence. In the past, people often remained with their families or married early for economic security. Today, with more women entering the workforce and career paths becoming more demanding, many young professionals can afford to maintain their own homes and prioritize their personal development over traditional family life. Additionally, social attitudes have shifted; living alone is no longer seen as a failure to integrate but as a sign of success and maturity. In urban centers, the availability of studio apartments and convenient services like food delivery makes a solitary lifestyle both feasible and attractive.

From a positive perspective, living alone fosters a high degree of self-reliance and personal freedom. Individuals can make all decisions—from decor to daily routines—without compromise, which can lead to greater self-awareness and confidence. However, there are notable negative consequences. Solitary living is significantly more expensive, as costs for rent and utilities are not shared. More importantly, it can lead to chronic loneliness and a lack of immediate social support in times of crisis or illness, which are major factors in the rising rates of depression. On a broader scale, if too many people live in isolation, the 'social fabric' of a community can weaken, leading to a society where individuals feel less connected to their neighbors.

In conclusion, while the trend toward living alone reflects the modern value of independence and is a positive step for personal growth, it also brings economic burdens and social risks. Balance is key, and society must find ways to ensure that those living alone remain socially integrated.

title: Preservation of Historical Sites
question: Some people think that historical sites and buildings should be preserved. Others believe that it is more important to build more houses and factories. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Bảo tồn di tích hay xây nhà/nhà máy?
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Di tích là kho tàng giáo dục và du lịch. Nhưng nhà ở/nhà máy là nhu cầu thiết yếu để phát triển kinh tế và dân sinh. Giải pháp: Quy hoạch thông minh, di dời nhà máy ra ngoại ô và bảo tồn di tích trung tâm.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Preserving historical sites (educational value, cultural identity, tourism revenue, architectural heritage).
View 2: Building houses and factories (solving housing crises, industrial growth, modernization, functional utility of land).
Opinion: Both are necessary; adaptive reuse of old buildings is a potential middle ground.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sử dụng thích ứng (biến cũ thành công năng mới)

sample:
The tension between heritage conservation and urban development is a common challenge for modern cities. While some prioritize the preservation of historical landmarks, others argue that land should be used for practical needs like housing and industry. I believe that a harmonious approach that values both history and progress is the most sustainable path.

Those who advocate for the preservation of historical sites emphasize their role as a 'living textbook.' These buildings provide a physical connection to the past, helping citizens understand their cultural roots and national identity. Moreover, historical sites are often major tourist attractions, bringing in vital foreign exchange and supporting local businesses. If a city loses its unique architectural heritage to make way for generic modern blocks, it risks losing its soul and its appeal to the world. For many, a city's history is its most valuable asset, one that cannot be replaced once destroyed.

On the other hand, proponents of new construction point to the pressing needs of a growing population. Many cities face severe housing shortages, leading to sky-high rents and overcrowding. In such cases, holding onto dilapidated old buildings may seem like a luxury that the poor cannot afford. Similarly, building new factories is essential for industrialization and creating jobs. Modern infrastructure is often more energy-efficient and functional than ancient structures, which can be expensive and difficult to maintain. From this perspective, the priority of any government should be the current well-being of its people rather than the static symbols of the past.

In conclusion, I believe that we do not have to choose one over the other. Successful cities are those that integrate their history into modern life, for example through 'adaptive reuse'—turning old factories into apartments or galleries. By protecting the most significant landmarks while allowing for modernization elsewhere, we can create vibrant cities that respect their past while looking toward the future.

title: Video Games: Impact on Children
question: In some countries, children are spending a lot of time playing video games. Is this a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Trẻ em chơi game nhiều.
Gợi ý: Tiêu cực là chính. Mặc dù game giúp phát triển phản xạ và tư duy chiến thuật, nhưng chơi quá nhiều gây béo phì, cận thị, suy giảm kết quả học tập và có thể dẫn đến hành vi hung hăng nếu game bạo lực.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Negative).
Body 1: Limited positive aspects (Improved hand-eye coordination, strategic thinking, digital literacy, social connection in multiplayer modes).
Body 2: Major negative impacts (Sedentary lifestyle leading to obesity, vision problems, addiction, academic neglect, exposure to violence leading to aggressive behavior).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
Video games have become one of the most popular forms of leisure for children worldwide. While gaming can offer some cognitive benefits, I believe that the excessive amount of time children spend on these platforms is a predominantly negative development for their physical and social well-being.

On the positive side, certain types of video games can enhance a child's mental faculties. Fast-paced action games have been shown to improve hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness, while strategy games can foster problem-solving skills and critical thinking. Furthermore, in an increasingly digital world, being comfortable with gaming hardware and software contributes to a child's overall digital literacy. For some, online multiplayer games also provide a social outlet where they can collaborate with peers and build friendships, provided the environment is safe and monitored.

However, the disadvantages far outweigh these benefits when gaming becomes a primary activity. The most immediate concern is the health impact of a sedentary lifestyle. Children who spend hours sitting in front of a screen are at a higher risk of childhood obesity, poor posture, and vision problems. Furthermore, the addictive nature of many modern games, designed with 'reward loops' to keep players engaged, often leads to academic neglect. When a child prioritizes gaming over homework or sleep, their cognitive and social development inevitably suffers. Perhaps most concerning is the exposure to violent content in many popular titles, which some studies suggest can desensitize children to real-world aggression and hinder the development of empathy.

In conclusion, while video games are not inherently harmful and can be a source of learning and fun, the current trend of excessive gaming is detrimental to children. Parents and educators must enforce strict time limits and encourage more diverse activities, such as sports and reading, to ensure a balanced upbringing.

title: Online Education vs Classroom Learning
question: In the future, online education will be more popular than traditional classroom learning. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Học online thay thế lớp học truyền thống.
Gợi ý: Cả hai (Balanced). Tích cực: Linh hoạt, chi phí thấp, tiếp cận toàn cầu. Tiêu cực: Thiếu tương tác xã hội, kỹ năng mềm bị mài mòn, sự chênh lệch về kỷ luật cá nhân.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Balanced).
Body 1: Positive aspects (Flexibility for working students, accessibility for remote areas, cost-effectiveness, personalized learning speed).
Body 2: Negative aspects (Loss of face-to-face interaction, lack of peer-to-peer learning, potential for distraction, erosion of social skills).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: tốc độ học tập cá nhân hóa
học tập giữa bạn bè cùng trang lứa

sample:
The rapid advancement of digital technology has made online education a mainstream alternative to traditional schools. While the shift toward virtual learning offers unprecedented flexibility and accessibility, I believe that the complete replacement of the classroom would be a predominantly negative development for social growth.

On the positive side, online education democratizes knowledge. It allows individuals in remote or underdeveloped areas to access world-class lectures and resources that were previously unavailable to them. Furthermore, the flexibility of digital platforms enables working professionals to upskill at their own pace without having to sacrifice their jobs. From an economic standpoint, online courses are often more affordable, as they eliminate the need for physical infrastructure and commuting costs. This makes higher education more inclusive, allowing a broader segment of the population to obtain degrees and certifications.

However, the lack of a physical learning environment has significant drawbacks. Classroom learning is not just about the transfer of information; it is a social experience where students learn essential soft skills such as teamwork, conflict resolution, and public speaking through direct interaction with teachers and peers. In a virtual setting, these nuanced social cues are often lost. Moreover, many students lack the self-discipline required to stay focused in a home environment filled with distractions. The spontaneous discussions and 'aha moments' that occur in a physical classroom are difficult to replicate through a computer screen, potentially leading to a more shallow educational experience.

In conclusion, while online education is an invaluable tool for flexibility and inclusivity, it should complement rather than replace the traditional classroom. A hybrid model that combines the convenience of digital resources with the social benefits of face-to-face instruction is the most promising path for the future of education.

title: Impact of Tourism Development
question: Many people believe that tourism is a major source of income for many countries. However, others think that it also causes many environmental and social problems. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Tác động của du lịch.
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Du lịch tạo việc làm, thúc đẩy kinh tế và bảo tồn văn hóa. Nhưng nó cũng gây ô nhiễm, phá hủy hệ sinh thái và làm xói mòn bản sắc địa phương (commercialization).
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Economic benefits (job creation in hospitality, foreign exchange earnings, infrastructure development, cultural promotion).
View 2: Problems (Environmental degradation, pollution, rising living costs for locals, loss of authentic culture through commercialization).
Opinion: Tourism is essential but must be managed through sustainable practices.
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
Tourism has become a global industry, serving as an economic lifeline for many developing nations. While its financial benefits are undeniable, the environmental and social costs associated with mass tourism cannot be ignored. I believe that tourism is a vital but dangerous force that requires strict regulation to remain beneficial.

On the one hand, the economic advantages of tourism are profound. For many countries with limited natural resources or industrial capacity, tourism is the primary source of foreign exchange and a major employer in the hospitality, transport, and retail sectors. The revenue generated can be reinvested into national infrastructure, such as airports and roads, which benefits the local population as well. Furthermore, tourism can act as a catalyst for cultural preservation, as communities strive to maintain their traditions, crafts, and historical sites to attract visitors. This global exposure can foster international understanding and pride in local heritage.

On the other hand, uncontrolled tourism often leads to severe environmental degradation. The construction of massive resorts can destroy fragile ecosystems like coral reefs or forests, and the influx of thousands of visitors leads to increased waste and pollution. Socially, the 'commercialization' of culture can turn sacred rituals into mere performances for profit, eroding their original meaning. Moreover, the influx of wealthy tourists often drives up the cost of living, making housing and basic goods unaffordable for the local residents. This 'gentrification' of tourist hotspots can create resentment and social tension between locals and visitors.

In conclusion, while tourism provides essential income and cultural exchange, its negative impacts on nature and society are significant. To ensure its long-term viability, governments must prioritize sustainable tourism models that limit visitor numbers in sensitive areas and ensure that the profits are used to protect the environment and support local communities.

title: Technology and Communication Skills
question: Some people think that the use of mobile phones and computers is having a negative effect on people's communication skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Công nghệ làm suy yếu kỹ năng giao tiếp.
Gợi ý: Đồng ý một phần. Tiêu cực: Làm giảm tương tác trực tiếp, gây hiểu lầm do thiếu ngôn ngữ cơ thể, làm con người lười giao tiếp sâu. Tích cực: Giúp kết nối xuyên biên giới, hỗ trợ giao tiếp cho người hướng nội hoặc khuyết tật.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase + Opinion (Partial Agreement).
Body 1: Negative effects (Erosion of face-to-face skills, reliance on emojis/text leading to misunderstandings, shorter attention spans, 'phubbing').
Body 2: Positive effects (Global connectivity, instant communication, aiding those with social anxiety or physical disabilities, efficiency in professional settings).
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: các tín hiệu xã hội tinh tế

sample:
The digital revolution has transformed how we interact, leading many to fear that our traditional communication skills are in decline. While I agree that the overuse of technology can erode our ability to engage in face-to-face conversations, I also believe it has created new and efficient ways to connect that were previously impossible.

On the negative side, the constant use of smartphones and computers has significantly reduced our opportunities for deep, in-person interaction. When we communicate primarily through text or social media, we lose out on the nuanced social cues such as body language, eye contact, and tone of voice that are essential for empathy and understanding. This often leads to misinterpretation and a more superficial level of connection. Furthermore, the phenomenon of 'phubbing'—ignoring those around us in favor of our screens—has damaged personal relationships and made people less present in social situations. For younger generations who have grown up with screens, the lack of practice in real-world dialogue can lead to a loss of confidence in social settings.

However, it is important to recognize the positive impact of technology on communication. The internet provides instant connectivity with people across the globe, allowing for the exchange of ideas and cultures on an unprecedented scale. For individuals with social anxiety or physical disabilities, digital platforms offer a vital lifeline to the world, enabling them to express themselves more freely than they might in person. In the professional sphere, tools like video conferencing and instant messaging have streamlined collaboration and made business communication more efficient. These tools do not necessarily destroy skills; they simply require a different set of digital literacies that are essential in the modern world.

In conclusion, while technology presents a risk to our traditional social abilities, it also offers powerful new ways to communicate. The key is to find a balance, ensuring that we prioritize real-world interaction while using digital tools to enhance rather than replace our human connections.

title: Fast Food Consumption Trends
question: In many countries, fast food is becoming more popular than traditional home-cooked meals. Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?
guide:
Chủ đề: Đồ ăn nhanh phổ biến hơn cơm nhà.
Gợi ý: Nguyên nhân: Nhịp sống hối hả, sự tiện lợi, giá rẻ, marketing mạnh mẽ. Đánh giá: Tiêu cực. Gây béo phì, bệnh tim mạch và làm mất đi truyền thống sum họp gia đình bên mâm cơm.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
Body 1: Reasons (Fast-paced modern lifestyle, convenience for busy workers, low cost compared to fresh ingredients, aggressive marketing by global chains).
Body 2: Evaluation (Predominantly negative: Health risks like obesity/diabetes; social impact: erosion of family bonding over meals; economic impact: decline of local culinary culture).
Conclusion: Summary.
sample:
The global dietary landscape has shifted significantly, with fast food outlets now rivaling or surpassing home-cooked meals in popularity. This trend is driven by the demands of modern life, but its long-term consequences for public health and social cohesion are deeply concerning.

There are several reasons for the rise of fast food. Firstly, the fast-paced nature of modern employment means that many people, particularly in urban areas, no longer have the time or energy to prepare meals from scratch. Fast food offers an immediate and convenient solution for busy individuals. Secondly, global food chains utilize aggressive marketing and economies of scale to offer meals at a price that is often lower than buying fresh, healthy ingredients. For low-income families, fast food can become a default choice for economic reasons. Finally, the high sugar, salt, and fat content of these meals are engineered to be highly palatable, creating a psychological preference for processed food over traditional dishes.

However, I believe this is a predominantly negative development. The most obvious impact is the health crisis; the surge in fast food consumption is directly linked to rising rates of obesity, heart disease, and type-2 diabetes worldwide. This places an immense burden on national healthcare systems. Socially, the decline of home cooking leads to the erosion of family bonding. Sharing a home-cooked meal is a traditional ritual that fosters communication and connection; when it is replaced by quick, solitary consumption of fast food, these social ties weaken. Furthermore, the dominance of global chains can lead to the loss of a nation's culinary heritage, as local recipes are forgotten in favor of standardized international flavors.

In conclusion, while the popularity of fast food is a logical response to the convenience and speed of modern life, it is a detrimental trend. To counter this, governments should implement health taxes on processed foods and promote the importance of traditional cooking in schools to protect both public health and cultural identity.

title: Preservation of Cultural Traditions
question: Some people think that it is important to preserve cultural traditions. Others believe that these traditions are no longer relevant in a modern, globalized world. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
guide:
Chủ đề: Bảo tồn truyền thống văn hóa.
Gợi ý: Cả hai. Một số người cho rằng truyền thống cản trở sự tiến bộ và hội nhập. Nhưng thực tế, truyền thống là la bàn đạo đức, là bản sắc riêng giúp con người không bị hòa tan trong biển toàn cầu hóa.
barem:
Introduction: Paraphrase.
View 1: Traditions are irrelevant (obstacle to progress, incompatible with modern values like gender equality, cost of maintenance, global integration requires uniformity).
View 2: Importance of preservation (national identity, moral compass, tourism asset, sense of belonging/continuity).
Opinion: Traditions should evolve but never be discarded; they are the foundation of who we are.
Conclusion: Summary.

vocab.meaning: sự đồng nhất hóa văn hóa

sample:
The forces of globalization have brought the world closer together, but they have also sparked a debate about the value of local traditions. While some argue that ancient customs are obsolete in a modern society, I believe that they are essential for maintaining our social fabric and individual identity.

On the one hand, critics of traditionalism argue that some customs can be an obstacle to social progress. Many traditions were established in a different era and may conflict with modern values such as gender equality or human rights. For example, certain traditional views on the role of women in the workforce or family are increasingly seen as restrictive. Furthermore, in a globalized economy, excessive focus on local customs might hinder a country's ability to integrate and collaborate with the international community. From this perspective, the drive toward a unified, global culture is seen as a way to reduce conflict and increase efficiency.

On the other hand, the preservation of cultural traditions provides individuals with a vital sense of belonging and continuity. In an ever-changing world, traditions act as a moral compass and a link to our ancestors, offering stability and shared values. Culture is what makes a nation unique; without it, we face the risk of 'cultural homogenization,' where every city looks and acts the same. Additionally, traditions are significant economic assets. Festivals, traditional crafts, and unique architecture attract millions of tourists, providing livelihoods for local communities. Protecting these assets is not just about nostalgia; it is about protecting a nation's economic and social diversity.

In conclusion, while some traditions may need to adapt to align with modern ethics, they should never be discarded entirely. I believe that a society without traditions is like a tree without roots—vulnerable and devoid of character. We should cherish our heritage as the foundation upon which we build our future.

title: Environmental Protection: Who is Responsible?
question: Some people think that individuals can do nothing to improve the environment. Only governments and large companies can make a real difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
guide:
Chủ đề: Trách nhiệm bảo vệ môi trường.
